intent: Show one or more month grids inline on the page and let the user pick one day, several days or a date range from them.
typical_uses: An always-visible calendar for picking a day or a range, such as a booking or scheduling view
A read-only month view that marks days through modifiers

dont_use_when.situation: A date field that opens a calendar from a trigger button or a typed field
A time of day, alone or next to a date

instead.note: Calendar selects whole days only; a time goes in its own field, such as an Input with `type="time"`.

invariants.text: With `onSelect` given, the grid shows `selected` on every render and a pick only calls `onSelect`, so a caller that does not store the value it receives sees the previous selection stay. Without `onSelect`, `selected` seeds the initial selection and the calendar keeps later picks in its own state.
`month` and `defaultMonth` are both accepted; `defaultMonth` seeds the initial state and is ignored afterwards, and when `month` is given it wins and the component follows it on every render.
Without `mode` and without `onDayClick`, days render as plain text with no buttons, so the grid can be neither focused day by day nor clicked.
In single mode, picking the day already selected clears the selection and calls `onSelect(undefined)`, unless `required` is set.

A key in `classNames` for a slot the kit styles (months, month, nav, the previous and next buttons, the caption, dropdown and grid slots, day, range_start, range_middle, range_end, today, outside, disabled, hidden) replaces the kit's class for that slot; a key for any other slot, `day_button` included, is added to it. A key in `components` replaces the kit's Chevron, DayButton or WeekNumber. A replacement DayButton loses the selection data attributes and the keyboard focus move unless it renders CalendarDayButton.

Arrow keys move the focused day (Shift+Left/Right by month, Shift+Up/Down by year), Page Up and Page Down move by month (Shift+Page Up/Down by year) and Home and End to the week's edges. Left and Right swap only when the `dir` prop is `rtl`; a direction inherited from an ancestor does not swap them.

anti_patterns.dont: Replace `components.DayButton` with a plain button to change how a day looks
anti_patterns.do_instead: Add a class through `modifiersClassNames` or `classNames.day_button`, which keep the kit's classes, or render CalendarDayButton inside the replacement

a11y.by: the primitive's DayPicker (role="grid" per month with aria-multiselectable in multiple and range mode, role="gridcell" with aria-selected per day, a roving tabindex over the day buttons and arrow, Page Up/Down, Home and End keyboard navigation, labelled previous and next month buttons), plus calendar.test.tsx asserting the grid role and a disabled day button's native disabled state

selected.states: selected is the current selection, a Date in single mode, a list of Dates in multiple mode and a `{ from, to }` date range in range mode
selected.because: `Date | Date[] | DateRange | undefined`, discriminated by `mode` and declared only by the three selection branches; the compiler emits one JSON type per property, and a Date object has no JSON Schema representation.

onSelect.states: onSelect is a callback called with the next selection, typed like `selected` for the active mode, plus the clicked date, its modifiers and the event, not a value
onSelect.because: `(selected, triggerDate, modifiers, e) => void`, whose first argument follows `mode` and `required` - functions, which no JSON Schema type covers.

disabled.states: disabled is a day matcher, one matcher or a list of them, that rules out the matching days
disabled.because: `Matcher | Matcher[]`, where a matcher is a boolean, a Date, a list of Dates, a range, a before/after bound, an interval, a day of the week or a function of the day; Dates and functions have no JSON Schema representation.

hidden.states: hidden is a day matcher, one matcher or a list of them, whose matching days are left out of the grid
hidden.because: The same `Matcher | Matcher[]` as `disabled`; Dates and functions have no JSON Schema representation.

modifiers.states: modifiers is an object mapping a custom modifier name to the day matcher it applies to
modifiers.because: `Record<string, Matcher | Matcher[] | undefined>`; the matchers hold Dates and functions, which have no JSON Schema representation.

modifiersClassNames.states: modifiersClassNames is an object mapping a modifier name to the class added to its days
modifiersClassNames.because: `ModifiersClassNames`, a map keyed by modifier names the caller chooses; the compiler leaves the named type to tsc.

modifiersStyles.states: modifiersStyles is an object mapping a modifier name to the inline style of its days
modifiersStyles.because: `ModifiersStyles`, a map of React style objects keyed by modifier names; the compiler leaves the named type to tsc.

classNames.states: classNames is an object mapping the library's slot names to a class, replacing or adding to the kit's class as `overrides-replace-the-kit-slots` states

styles.because: `Partial<Styles>`, React style objects keyed by slot name; the compiler leaves the named type to tsc.

unexposed_parts.reason: The kit's Chevron slot, one of four directional icons chosen by the library's `orientation`, styled by calendar.module.css's `.chevron`.
The kit's WeekNumber slot, a table cell wrapping the number in a div styled by `.weekNumberCell`, rendered only with `showWeekNumber`.

good.title: One day
good.code:
const [date, setDate] = useState<Date | undefined>();
<Calendar mode="single" selected={date} onSelect={setDate} />

good.title: A range over two months with weekends ruled out
good.code:
const [range, setRange] = useState<DateRange | undefined>();
<Calendar mode="range" selected={range} onSelect={setRange} numberOfMonths={2} disabled={{ dayOfWeek: [0, 6] }} />

good.title: Month and year dropdowns in the caption

bad.title: A picker with no mode
bad.why: Without `mode` the days are not buttons and nothing can be picked; `onSelect` is never called.

bad.title: A made-up defaultSelected prop for an uncontrolled calendar
bad.why: There is no `defaultSelected`; pass `selected` without `onSelect` to seed a selection the calendar then keeps itself.
